an5.248:1.1: pañcime bhikkhave ādīnavā manoduccarite katame pañca attāpi attānaṃ upavadati anuvicca viññū garahanti pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati saddhammā vuṭṭhāti asaddhamme patiṭṭhāti ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā manoduccarite. pañcime bhikkhave ādīnavā manosucarite
an5.248:1.8: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā manosucariteti.
